description: Two red binders, artificially titled Recipe Binder 1 and Recipe Binder 2. Recipe Binder 1 contains an article clipping, "Making Food Tasty Without Salt" by Jane Kinderlehrer, taped to the inside back cover. Recipe Binder 2 contains a handwritten curried chicken recipe and a clipping of a vanilla rennet custard recipe taped to the inside front cover.
title: Recipe binders
